title: Scalar Gaussian FP32 Precision Control
intuition: Full-precision FP32 control baseline on N(2, 0.5^2) matched bit-for-bit in data, architecture, and budget against the MXFP8 and NVFP4 low-precision tasks.
failure_mode: If a recipe fails the FP32 control, failures on MXFP8/NVFP4 cannot be attributed to low-precision quantization.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 diagnostic control pairing directly with `precision_gaussian_mxfp8` and `precision_gaussian_nvfp4`.
